entities.name: Adolphe Dureau de la Malle

entities.summary: Adolphe Jules César Auguste Dureau de la Malle was a French geographer, naturalist, historian and artist. He was the son of the scholar and translator Jean-Baptiste Dureau de la Malle and mother from Saint-Domingue.
